```sql
SELECT SUM(ps.points)
FROM main.results r
JOIN main.races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN main.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN main.points_scheme ps ON r.positionOrder = ps.position AND ps.scheme_id = 'PS2009'
WHERE d.driverRef = 'button'
  AND ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.date <= '2009-12-31'
```
